author: JEANNIE BAITINGER Correspondent
title: Kids' Day on the Farm coming to Bulls Gap - NewsBreak
text: BULLS GAP — The third annual Kids’ Day on the Farm is scheduled for Saturday, July 19 from 11 a.m. until 4 p.m. in the park at 229 N. VFW Road in Bulls Gap. This year offers the biggest event yet. It includes a junior paleontologist who will bring fossils to view and will help children identify any old fossils they may have found. Kids’ Day on the Farm activities include: Hamburgers, hot dogs, barbecue and drinks free for kids Book signings by four authors11 trackless train ridesBounce housesSix waterslidesPetting zooTWRA info and giveaway tableHands-on museum with junior paleontologist show with fossilsFace paintingsSlushiesProfessional balloon twisterHouse of a Million and One BubblesBulls Gap food pantry with giveaway tableBulls Gap Baptist Church with info and giveaway tablePenny with shoot the ducks to win a prize carnival gameDillon Williams, street magicianDanny Robinett’s cowboy campTennessee Fur harvesters with animal IDCotton candy fishing gameMountain man dress up (have that camera ready!)Bulls Gap Lions Club with a machine to check anyone’s eyesMyers greenhouse and Pumpkin Patch with stand-up poster for picsDunk tankBackpack giveaway20 bicycles to be given awayTroop 21 Rangers with a flag retirement and demonstration on how to properly fold the U.S. flag. Though the weather will be hot, the water activities will help attendees keep cool, and free bottles of cold water will be available for everyone. Thanks to local sponsors, everything is free for the children. Kids from throughout the region, not just Bulls Gap, are invited. Subscribe to The Rogersville Review
